name: Green-to-red band ratio
description: Ratio of green to red reflectance per pixel; values above 1 mean green exceeds red.
method: ratio = G / R on 0-1 scaled bands; undefined where R is zero
interpret_source:
def interpret(evidence):
    m = evidence["metrics"]
    asset = evidence["asset"]
    summary = (f"{asset['label']}: the green-to-red ratio has a mean of {m['matrix_mean']:.3f} per cell, "
               f"from {m['matrix_min']:.3f} to {m['matrix_max']:.3f}.")
    findings = [{"id": "F1", "statement": f"The median-aggregated green/red ratio spans {m['matrix_min']:.3f} to "
                                           f"{m['matrix_max']:.3f} (standard deviation {m['matrix_std']:.3f}).",
                 "evidence": ["matrix_min", "matrix_max", "matrix_std"]}]
    steps = [{"type": "human_inspection",
              "description": "Inspect cells with the highest ratio in the source image to see which surfaces they correspond to.",
              "follows_from": "F1"}]
    return {"summary": summary, "findings": findings, "next_steps": steps}
